segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Dana at Northbridge Supply. I’m calling on ticket 48217. We just need the SFTP password reset for our nightly export user, nb-export@northbridge, before our 9 p.m. job.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. Let me pull up the ticketing system and your account in the admin console. Can you confirm the last four digits on your customer ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, it’s 1148. Account name is Northbridge Supply, Chicago office.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I see you listed as an authorized admin, and the export user is active. I’m going to reset the credential now and send the temporary password to the secure contact email we have on file, ops-it@northbridge.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, that’s the right inbox. And yeah, we’ll rotate it on our side once we log in.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, it’s done. The email should arrive in the next two or three minutes. The temporary password expires on August 6 at 5 p.m. Central if it’s not used.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: All right, I see it just came through. That should cover us.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I’ll mark ticket 48217 as resolved with the reset timestamp. If anything fails on the 9 p.m. export, just reply to that ticket and we can reopen it.
